integrity: The critical threshold is attributed to prior interfacial-wave literature, not claimed as new. The contribution claimed is the global uniqueness and monotonicity classification proved from the exact dispersion denominator.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to linear interfacial gravity-capillary waves in two inviscid, incompressible homogeneous layers of finite depth with rigid horizontal lids and no background current.
It proves uniqueness and monotonicity of the linear phase-speed curve but does not give a closed-form minimizing wavenumber or prove nonlinear solitary-wave existence or stability.
The earliest source record specifies July 1993 at issue-month precision; the required date field uses month-start normalization and does not assert that the article appeared on that exact day.
title: Unique phase-speed minimum for finite-depth two-layer gravity-capillary waves
